pricing_usd_per_mtok.basis: Cached list price for claude-opus-5-5 as of 2026-10-06; must be re-verified against the provider before any approved run. Computed cost is an estimate, not an invoice.

transmitted_fields: candidate entity_id, display_name, entity_type, rank, similarity_score, score_kind
matched alias id and text, evidence_id, alias source and synthetic flag, provenance snapshot_id and dataset

notes: Live provider calls are BLOCKED until the owner sets every approval field, a positive budget, max_requests_per_run and live_enabled, and passes an explicit allow-live flag.
No tool use, no streaming, no server-side refusal fallback: a fallback model would silently change the compared model. A refusal is recorded and the deterministic path is used.
The API key is read only from the environment variable named in api_key_env and is never logged or stored in receipts.

Before every call the client refuses a rendered request longer than max_request_chars and any call whose worst-case cost (UTF-8 bytes of the request + 64 input tokens, plus capped max_tokens, at the listed prices) would take spending past budget_usd. The worst case is charged up front and replaced by reported usage.
